datasetName: STAR class sizes and classroom aides: experimental results (Krueger, 1999)
datasetDescription: Measured achievement effects from Tennessee’s randomized class-size experiment, organized by grade and assigned classroom condition. Effects are percentile points, with standard errors and source citations.
rctDescription: A research design that assigns participants to intervention or comparison conditions by a random process.

gradeLevels.name: Kindergarten (United States)
gradeLevels.description: The United States school grade preceding first grade.

gradeLevels.name: First grade (United States)
gradeLevels.description: The first numbered grade in United States elementary education, following kindergarten.

gradeLevels.name: Second grade (United States)
gradeLevels.description: The second numbered grade in United States elementary education, following first grade.

gradeLevels.name: Third grade (United States)
gradeLevels.description: The third numbered grade in United States elementary education, following second grade.

armType.name: Study arm
armType.description: A study-specific group defined by its assigned intervention or comparison condition. Assignment, participation and changes over time must be distinguished.

arms.name: STAR small-class assignment
arms.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 13–17 students in Tennessee Project STAR.

arms.name: STAR regular-class assignment with full-time aide
arms.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 22–25 students with a full-time classroom aide in Tennessee Project STAR.

arms.sourceLabel: regular class without a full-time aide
arms.name: STAR regular-class comparison assignment
arms.description: Initial assignment to a class planned for 22–25 students without a full-time aide in Tennessee Project STAR. Some regular classes had part-time aide access in grades 1–3.

properties.name: Grade levels
properties.description: School-grade concepts relevant to a record, with the education system identified by each target.

properties.name: Intervention arms
properties.description: Study-specific assigned intervention groups evaluated by an outcome estimate.

properties.name: Comparison arms
properties.description: Study-specific assigned comparison groups used as the reference for an outcome estimate.

identityDecision: Reuse the existing Study type, Study categories relation, RCT category and Tennessee place. Create the study-specific arms and US grade concepts after completed all-space exact and alias searches; retain the separate glossary RCT ID. Add the missing RCT definition only in Education datasets, leaving Health unchanged.
limitations: This batch does not establish compatible observed costs or standard-deviation conversions. Full program, implementation, instrument and population mappings remain required by the dashboard contract.
